about_the_game:
Patients believe you work miracles. And they're right — for only a miracle could save them... from you.

You are a healer keeping an antidote shop, living in an age where poison has become as common as air. Study manuals detailing poisons and their cures. Examine patients through your magnifying lens, hunting for the faintest traces of toxins and symptoms.

The fog is spreading

The Fog's poison is ever-changing — no two cases alike. Toxins mimic common ailments to deceive even seasoned healers. Hesitation is fatal. Even a breeze spreads death for miles. Your tattered antidote manual is all that stands between humanity and extinction.

Who holds the right to decide?

As the keeper of life-saving antidotes, you alone choose who receives treatment — and who is left to the Fog’s mercy. Will you heal blindly, or decide who is worthy of survival?

short_description: An antidote shop simulator in a grimdark setting. Save lives by diagnosing poison types and administering precious cures. Or risk playing executioner in white gloves — save one, slip another a fake cure and watch how your choice echoes through this rotten world.
